{
  "correction_rules": [
    "Adjust forecasts downward when sentiment history shows low positivity (e.g., 0.00) and model overestimates prices.",
    "Reduce forecast magnitude when recent history shows strong upward momentum but true outcome reverses sharply.",
    "Increase forecast sensitivity to recent low prices (e.g., <65) when sentiment is neutral or negative.",
    "Apply mean reversion bias: if forecast is >75 and true outcome is <70, reduce forecast by 5-10%.",
    "Correct for lag: if true outcome is significantly higher than 3-day average of forecast, adjust forecast upward by 2-5%.",
    "Avoid overshoot after spikes: if model peaks above 75 after a spike, cap forecast at 74-75 unless sentiment confirms bullish trend.",
    "Use sentiment as trigger: if sentiment > 0.5, increase forecast by 2-3% for next period; if sentiment < 0.3, reduce by 2-3%."
  ]
}
